design: Tall broad mature chief guard, silver-grey speckled hide, uncovered wide mandibled alien face with long ivory tusks, thick dreadlocks to mid-back secured by one wide bronze band. Unique half-helmet with low forward crest and flared side guards leaves jaw exposed. Polished black overlapping ceremonial guard breastplate edged with worn bronze geometric lines, one broad domed shoulder plate and one layered narrow pauldron, dark wine waist sash, charcoal three-panel skirt, high segmented greaves. Holds a tall straight spear with compact forked tip upright in left hand; right hand at a closed disc case. Dignified alert neutral pose.
